lines.zh: 我踩过沙丘，六条腿齐动。
lines.en: I cross the dune on six moving legs.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳在太阳下发亮。
lines.en: My shell shines in the sun.
I head for the movement ahead.

lines.zh: 我的触角扫过前面的沙。
lines.en: My antennae sweep the sand ahead.
I keep low and shift sideways.
I kick the sand into a trail.
I come up around the back of the dune.
I pause to get my bearings.

lines.zh: 我的前肢举着，像在探路。
lines.en: My forelimbs are up, feeling the way.
I go around the big stone.
I advance in short bursts.
I head for the camp.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等后面的同伴。
lines.en: I pause and wait for the ones behind me.
I speed up again.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的沙继续走。
lines.en: I shake the sand off my back and keep going.
I move along with my body arched.
I lie on the sand with my legs drawn in.
My antennae test the air.

lines.zh: 我在听地下的声音，沙粒在动。
lines.en: I listen below; the sand grains move.
A layer of sand sits on my shell.
My mandibles open and close twice.
The heat suits me.
I wait for the others to return.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向有味道的一边。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the scent.

lines.zh: 我把前肢收在口器下面。
lines.en: I tuck my forelimbs under my mandibles.
A desert warrior bug with hard legs.
The sand moves on the wind.
My mandibles bite at nothing.
You're three paces ahead of me.
I raise my head, mandibles open.
Your scent is new.
I turn my whole body to you.
You carry metal.
Sand lies between us.
You stand between me and the nest mouth.
My shell is harder than your boots.
This sand is ours.
Don't run; you'd be slow anyway.
You knocked a pale scar into my shell.
I shift half a step off.
My legs lost their grip.

lines.zh: 虫群占了沙漠，我是前排。
lines.en: The swarm holds the desert; I am the front line.
My shell tilted, I straighten it.
My shell rings from the blow.
I wobble and hold.
I steady all six legs.
I've kept that direction.

lines.zh: 我的甲上多了一道，我还没倒下。
lines.en: Another mark on my shell; I am not down.
That meat is in the sand.
I reach for it with my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 我踩过沙丘，六条腿齐动，闻到血。
lines.en: I cross the dune on six legs and smell blood.

lines.zh: 沙漠已经归我们虫群了。
lines.en: The desert belongs to our swarm now.
I tear off a piece with my mandibles.
The moment that meat moves, I pounce.
I bite into it and drag it toward the nest.
Sand has covered it.
I dig it out with my forelimbs.
I drag it back to the nest.

lines.zh: 你的冲劲全卸在我甲上。
lines.en: Your momentum breaks on my shell.
All six of my legs hold ground.
That impact buckles your knee.
My legs caught your boot.
Between us we've churned the sand.
I flatten against the ground.
My shell hasn't cracked at all.
I shift aside, then shove right back.

lines.zh: 我的关节被你压得咯吱响。
lines.en: My joint grinds under your weight.
I'm shifting toward you again.
There's a queen in the nest.
Pairing is the queen's business.
We touch antennae, one to another.
That's how we pass word.
There are roads under the sand.
I keep watch on the outer ring.
Whoever comes close gets handled.
We pass word only by antennae.
We only do the work.
Sand keeps drifting over the nest mouth.
In the desert swarm, I lead.
I bring it up to my mandibles.
Too heavy to drag.
I bite off a corner.
It's stuck to my leg.
I cover it with sand.
I drag it a stretch.
This thing is hard.
I dropped it in the sand.
I'll drag this back to the nest.
Footsteps are shaking the sand toward me.
I open my mandibles as wide as they go.
I've kept its shadow.

lines.zh: 虫群战士的口器，张开了。
lines.en: The swarm warrior's mandibles open.
It's under five blocks away.
I start running at it.
Sand flies under my feet.
It's still digging.
I cut off its path to the right first.
I push off with my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我从沙里窜出，直取后腿。
lines.en: I burst from the sand and go for its hind leg.
My mandibles have it.
I run low over the sand.
I swing to its rear flank.
My legs are fast.
It's backed below the dune.
I crawl two blocks closer along the sand.
It lifted a foot.
I duck low.
Sand blurs my sight.
I climb the dune and come from the top.
This bite goes for its leg.
It's running hard enough to pant.
One more step.

lines.zh: 我的口器夹住你的小腿。
lines.en: My mandibles clamp onto your calf.
My forelimbs pin it.
My mandibles sink into its hide.
My forelimbs sweep it away.
I wrench it down with my mandibles.
You dodge and I plunge into the sand.
I lunge in again from the side.
It kicked my head.
I pull back.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出的血被沙吸干。
lines.en: The sand drinks the blood from the wound.
I come up out of the sand.
Sand still clings to my shell.
This sand is ours.
First my mandibles work.
I look up the dune.
The wind spreads my scent.

lines.zh: 沙漠的战士虫，前肢张着。
lines.en: A desert warrior bug, forelimbs spread.
My kind are digging nearby.
I go along the dune crest that way.

lines.zh: 太阳把沙晒烫，我爬出来。
lines.en: The sun bakes the sand; I crawl out.

lines.zh: 火烧得我的甲发烫，我往沙里钻。
lines.en: The fire heats my shell and I dig into the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，翻了几圈。
lines.en: I roll down the dune several turns.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的甲缝，腿都软了。
lines.en: Water gets into my shell and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀到半空又砸下来。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and slams me down.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的甲里，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shell.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: That light leaves my legs unresponsive.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我的口器都发软。
lines.en: Hungry too long, and my mandibles feel soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and I lock up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有沙了，我一路掉。
lines.en: No sand underfoot, and I fall.
